purpose: Route-local sampler convergence, mixing, stopping, and diagnostic controls for OQ-0106.

convergence_diagnostic_rows.convergence_diagnostic_class: route-local convergence / mixing / stopping diagnostic denominator
convergence_diagnostic_rows.diagnostic_object: Route-local R-hat, effective sample size, autocorrelation time, trace-rank diagnostic, nested-sampling shrinkage/evidence diagnostic, HMC acceptance/divergence diagnostic, benchmark stability criterion, or metadata-only diagnostic invoked by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
convergence_diagnostic_rows.stopping_rule: Declare convergence diagnostic thresholds, multimodality checks, chain/replica independence, seed sensitivity, posterior predictive or holdout checks, and replayable stopping criteria before spending convergence language.
convergence_diagnostic_rows.residual_gap: A passed diagnostic is not a proof of convergence to the target distribution, adequate tail coverage, unbiased evidence, global mode discovery, or candidate identity.
convergence_diagnostic_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer route promotion, public-record closure, exact inference, or physical representativeness from sampler convergence diagnostics alone.
